_comment: sim-robust-transfer-settle-oscillation-v1 live_pose TRANSFER PICK wrist-branch fix. Purpose: stop the live_pose transfer PICK CONTACT descent from intermittently limit-cycling. coldwin12 (byte-identical to the PASSING coldwin11, fresh commission, no injection) failed at the transfer pick contact: the cuMotion task-space APPROACH IK landed on the ur_wrist_2-vs-ur_forearm self-colliding family (wrist_1 1.171 above the ~0.69 stop, wrist_2 -1.033 below 0), the straight-line contact descent (contact_straight_line) inherited that branch and limit-cycled 0.169 rad / ~1.6 rad/s on wrist_1/wrist_2/wrist_3 for the WHOLE 30 s settle window (TRAJ_HOST_FAULT 'pose not bounded within settle window: position peak 0.1690 > goal tol 0.010 rad'), and PR239's terminal-settle envelope CORRECTLY rejected it -> HOST_FAULT_ESTOP op=transfer -> 'arm command heartbeat lost'. coldwin11 took the clear wrist_2-positive family (wrist_1 -0.18, wrist_2 +0.93) and settled instantly. The carry RESTOCK_TRANSFER_CARRY=wrist_guard covers only the PLACE half (preplace/place/retreat); the PICK was unguarded. Merge this ONE HOST-config key into the mission runtime-config HOST block (read by scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_host.py). Absent/false => byte-identical.
_transfer_pick_wrist_guard_note: true => the live_pose transfer PICK approach + contact IK is bounded to the clear carry wrist region (ur_wrist_1 <= carry_wrist1_cap, ur_wrist_2 >= carry_wrist2_min; the HOST block's existing 0.65 / 0.0). The APPROACH (cuMotion task-space pose goal) carries those as goal joint constraints so cuMotion IKs the clear wrist_2-positive family (the coldwin11 branch, which provably reaches this live carton TCP). The CONTACT (straight-line seeded-KDL IK seeded from the approach) is wrist-guarded: a resolved config outside the clear region re-seeds from its wrist-flipped twin (same TCP, clear branch), or fails fast by the named reason 'IK outside the carry wrist region (wrist_1<=0.65, wrist_2>=0.0)' rather than descending into the stop. On a MOVE_RETRY phase=contact the move re-plans onto the clear branch from the live pose instead of replaying the colliding goal. It reuses the proven fm327/fm403 _pose_plan_goal joint constraints and the wrist_guard _guard_rejects re-seed -- no new thresholds, no controller gain change, PR239's settle envelope untouched.
_scope: Scoped to the live_pose transfer PICK (RESTOCK_TRANSFER_MODE=live_pose + operation=transfer), phases approach and contact only. The preplace/place/retreat place half (its own carry wrist_guard + PR243 reach guard), the LIFT (its own carry_wrist1_cap/carry_wrist2_min), collect, and every non-live_pose transfer are untouched. coldwin11 already took the clear family at IK, so this key leaves that run byte-identical in outcome.
_requires: RESTOCK_TRANSFER_MODE=live_pose active for the run, and the HOST block's existing clear-region bounds carry_wrist1_cap (0.65) and carry_wrist2_min (0.0). Register transfer_pick_wrist_guard in the run's --require preflight (config_preflight knows it as a HOST key).
_bounded_gpu_proof: Primary: the staged transfer-only run (start_staging=recorded_bay_park, start_at=transfer, stop_after=transfer), repeated a BOUNDED number of times (e.g. 4) with this key merged into the HOST block. PASS = EVERY pick contact move settles within tolerance -- no 'TRAJ_HOST_FAULT pose not bounded', no 'MOVE_RETRY phase=contact' storm, no HOST_FAULT_ESTOP op=transfer; HOST_EFFECTIVE_CONFIG shows transfer_pick_wrist_guard active; the console logs a clear APPROACH plan / a 'WRIST_GUARD accept' with wrist_2 >= 0 at the contact. NOTE the intermittency is a full-chain live-carton-pose dependency; the staged start may always land the clear family, so the real confirmation is the full COLD capstone (collect -> couple -> outbound -> park -> transfer -> verify) re-run with this key on -- expect the transfer to proceed through place/verify with no sustained-oscillation fault. GPU rules: one run at a time under flock /tmp/aile-gpu.lock, never forced, HEAVY_MB=2500 for the always-on whispr (~2.2 GB), never touch whispr (pid 1339).
